job.title: [Post] We're expanding our team and looking for talented professionals for the following position…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, building headless, B2B/B2C commerce experiences. Proven track record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines, and micro-service APIs, while driving production support and CI/CD deployments. Strong techno-functional consulting skills enable precise requirement analysis and stakeholder collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Mauzma Shehnaz because of its innovative approach to B2C commerce and its commitment to delivering seamless digital experiences. With over five years of building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless commerce, REST/OCC APIs and complex PIM-ERP integrations that align perfectly with the SFCC developer role.

bullets.label: Headless API Development
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services, delivering headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, mirroring the API-first focus of SFCC.

bullets.label: PIM/ERP Integration
bullets.text: I built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring synchronized product data across global B2C channels.

bullets.label: Production-Ready Deployments
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and managed Docker/Kubernetes environments, guaranteeing reliable releases for high-traffic e-commerce sites.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Working closely with business stakeholders, I translated requirements into functional specifications and user stories, driving successful commerce solutions from design to production.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: At Mauzma Shehnaz I see a forward-thinking team that combines cutting-edge technology with a strong focus on B2C customer experiences. Your recent expansion into advanced e-commerce platforms aligns with my background in headless SAP Commerce Cloud solutions and complex data integrations. I am eager to apply my Java-centric, API-driven expertise to help you accelerate product delivery and create seamless shopper journeys.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive innovative B2C commerce solutions at Mauzma Shehnaz, delivering robust APIs and seamless integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud role at Mauzma Shehnaz and would love to discuss how my headless API and integration expertise can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer (SFCC)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, REST/OCC API, and integration expertise. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
